statement_map.email_excerpt: Your customers were not getting the order confirmation email after they bought, even though you had connected your payment gateway.
Following our guidance, you switched on the order confirmation email for your product and saved it, and after your test order you confirmed the confirmation email arrived in your inbox.
The email still showed the default sender name, and we explained that you can change it under Email settings, Sender name.
Change the sender name under Email settings to your brand name (you mentioned you'd do this after the call).
